input: Label all the breaker switches in the fuse box

gold.taskTitle: Label all breaker switches in the fuse box
gold.taskDescription: Identify and label every breaker switch in the fuse box so each one is clearly marked with the circuit or area it controls.

questions.title: How many breakers are currently in the fuse box?
questions.description: Find out the total number of breaker switches that need to be labeled to scope the effort.

questions.title: Are any breakers already labeled, partially or fully?
questions.description: Determine how much existing labeling is in place to avoid redundant work.

questions.title: Do you know which breaker controls which circuit?
questions.description: Assess whether a circuit mapping already exists or needs to be discovered from scratch.

questions.title: What method will you use to identify unknown circuits?
questions.description: Clarify the approach for testing circuits, such as using a circuit tracer, a helper, or a plug-in lamp.

questions.title: What type of labels will you use on the breakers?
questions.description: Determine the labeling format, such as handwritten paper, printed adhesive labels, or a label maker.

questions.title: Is the fuse box inside, outside, or in a hard-to-access spot?
questions.description: Understand the physical location and any access challenges that could affect how the work is done.

questions.title: Is there a deadline or reason this needs to be done soon?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as a home inspection, sale, or recent electrical work, to set priority.
